app.name: Ylide
app.tagline: Code with AI that never leaves your computer.

switchProject.title: Discard unsaved changes?

errors.no_model: No model is running. Start one in the model menu.
errors.network_disabled: This network access is switched off in the settings.
errors.model_not_installed: This model is not downloaded yet.
errors.server: The model server reported a problem: {{message}}
errors.endpoint_unreachable: The external server is not reachable: {{message}}
errors.not_found: The file could not be found.
errors.not_gguf: This is not a GGUF model file.
errors.busy: Please wait, another installation is running.
errors.update_none: There is no update to install. Check for updates first.
errors.update_busy: The update is already being installed.
errors.update_signature: The update was refused because its signature does not match. Nothing was installed.
errors.update_format: The update has a format Ylide cannot install: {{message}}
errors.update_too_large: The update is unusually large and was not downloaded.
errors.update_launch: The installer could not be started: {{message}}
errors.update_unsupported: On this system, install updates by hand.
errors.skill_invalid: This is not a valid skill: {{message}}
errors.skill_exists: A skill with this name is installed already ({{message}}). Remove it first to install it again.
errors.skill_renamed: The new version has another name ({{message}}). Remove the skill and add the new one.
errors.skill_address: That is not the address of a GitHub repository: {{message}}
errors.skill_repo_not_found: GitHub does not know this repository, or it is private.
errors.skill_rate_limited: GitHub's limit for requests without an account is used up. Try again in an hour.
errors.skill_gone: The skill is no longer in its repository: {{message}}
errors.no_vision: The model that is running cannot see images. On the Models page, switch on “Understand images” for a model that can.
errors.not_projector: This is not an image module (mmproj GGUF file).
errors.no_projector: This model has no image input.

images.label: Image {{n}}: {{name}}, {{size}} pixels
images.noModel: Start a model that understands images to attach them.
images.switchOn: {{model}} can understand images: switch on “Understand images” for it on the Models page and start it again.
images.missing: The image module of {{model}} is missing. Switch “Understand images” off and on again on the Models page.
images.failed: {{model}} runs without image input because its image module did not load. The server log has the details.

problem.unsupported: Only PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF images can be attached.
problem.tooLarge: The image is larger than 20 MB.
problem.damaged: The image could not be read.
problem.tooMany: At most {{max}} images per message; the rest were not attached.

reasons.fitsInVram: Fits completely into your graphics memory ({{vramGb}} GB used).
reasons.moeOffload: Mixture of experts: the always-active part and {{vramGb}} GB stay on the GPU, {{cpuExpertLayers}} expert layers ({{ramGb}} GB) live in system RAM. Only a few experts run per token, so this stays fast.
reasons.partialOffload: {{gpuLayers}} layers run on the GPU ({{vramGb}} GB), the rest in system RAM ({{ramGb}} GB). This works, but is slower.
reasons.unifiedMemory: Runs in unified memory ({{ramGb}} GB) on the Apple GPU.
reasons.cpuOnly: Runs on the processor ({{ramGb}} GB of RAM). No suitable GPU was found.
reasons.topQualityForBudget: The strongest coding model that runs well on this machine.
reasons.toolCalling: Reliable tool use for agent mode ({{level}}).
reasons.longContext: Long context of {{tokens}} tokens: enough for large files and long agent sessions.
reasons.reasoningModel: Can think before answering; Ylide turns this off for quick edits.
reasons.restrictedLicense: {{license}}: check the license terms before commercial use.
reasons.slowWarning: This will feel slow on this machine.
reasons.quantizedKvCache: Uses a compressed context cache ({{type}}) to fit.
reasons.sharesGpuWithMain: Runs on the GPU next to the main model.
reasons.runsOnCpu: Runs on the processor and leaves the GPU to the main model.
reasons.autocompleteMovesToCpu: Uses the GPU memory otherwise reserved for autocomplete.
reasons.noGpu: No suitable graphics card was found. Models run on the processor, which is slower.
reasons.lowDiskSpace: Only {{freeGb}} GB of disk space is free.
reasons.nothingFits: None of the known models fits this machine. You can still use your own GGUF file or an external server.

update.availableBody: Installing takes about a minute, then Ylide restarts.
update.confirmBody: The update is downloaded and checked. Ylide now stops the model, installs the update and then restarts.
update.confirmDirty_one: One file has unsaved changes. Save it first, or the changes are lost.
update.confirmDirty_other: {{count}} files have unsaved changes. Save them first, or the changes are lost.
update.confirmAgent: The running agent will be stopped.
